Onoff_coupled_options.type: p entry is STRING containing JSON array of seven-character hex strings; not raw JSON array
Onoff_coupled_options.native_guard_bug: 0x8065e24 tests index<size rather than index+1<size; final/lone stringOnoff reads missing next opt and faults at NULL. Do not claim standalone native Onoff command success.
Onoff_coupled_options.companion: Unconditionally processes NEXT p as Scenecontrol string after comparing NEXT opt to Scenecontrol; strcmp result is ignored. Then consumes next index. Safe model requires literal Scenecontrol companion and validates both before mutation.
Onoff_coupled_options.packet: 20 bytes: AA AA, zero-filled prefix; byte9=8,10=0x20,11=selectedscene slot iff pending16 is positive else0;12..13=firsttwo %2X bytes;14..16=three converted nibble bytes;17..19=0. Callback copies literal20-byte template0x8063fe4.
Onoff_coupled_options.nibbles: Each trailing char: char<ASCII A subtract0x30 else subtract0x57, stored uint8. lowercasea/f->10/15; uppercaseA/F->234/239! Prefix %2X parsing accepts uppercase independently. Safe parser can require lowercase exact sevenhex bytes, or preserve source uppercase wrapping explicitly.
Onoff_coupled_options.queue: Separate30-entry ring of20-byte records at0x100128d0. Compare full20-byte records against active entries; identical record omitted. Otherwise append and advance write, overwrite oldest on full. Not the five-entry200-byte scene ring.
Onoff_coupled_options.wire_status: Onoff getter is fixed OK, not queue delivery/physical state proof.

Sceneid.type: String decimal conversion through identified ROM prvAtoi0xd9d0; new probe substitutes only nonnegative all-digit inputs<=signed32, not malformed/negative ROM tolerance.
Sceneid.requested_effective: If conversion result>=0, store low16 current_scene_id FIRST. Match registry entries by that uint16; set selectedslot(index+1) and result1. If absent and count<30, append6-byte entry(id at+2), increment count, set slot and result1 after persistence wrapper. If full, current_scene_id still changed but result=-1 and registry unchanged.
Sceneid.getters: Sceneid and Scenecontrol emit current_scene_id from rootcontext+0x24, NOT numeric scratch13/15. Scene emits OK iff rootcontext+0x28 nonzero, FAIL otherwise. Negative result -1 is NONZERO, so source Scene getter emits OK even after full-table failure!
Sceneid.capacity_failure_example: 30 IDs1..30; stringSceneid31 -> currentID31,result=-1,selected prior slot retained, no new registry entry. Follow-up Scene getter checks nonzero (-1), so string is OK, not inferred failure.

Scene.type: String containing JSON array of seven-character records, same prefix2hexbytes and raw nibble transform as Onoff
Scene.record: Absolute queuebase+200*write_slot: byte12=5*N+3,13=0x21,14=selectedslot, entries15.. each5bytes. Snapshot includes queuebase itself; header[0:3] does not add3 to these source offsets. Literal sample bytes0821010102010a0f span snapshot[12:20]. Max37 bounded records remains safe.
Scene.lifecycle: If root scene_result!=0, enqueue scene write and possible control frame according to pending+0x12; if result0, buffer may be assembled but ring write index/count not advanced. Set pending+0x12=0x4003 and selectedslot0 regardless after valid JSON path. Getter ACK uses source result-based OK/FAIL, NOT proof that queue advanced.
Scene.empty_array: Still a valid three-byte scene payload when selected/result allow staging. Do not fabricate a physical scene effect.
Scene.malformed: Native parse failure can still return preexisting OK through outer getter, after companion state side effects. Bounded model rejects malformed payload atomically before changes.

Scenecontrol.type: String decimal ROM conversion, low16 currentID write before registry search
Scenecontrol.match: If existing ID matches, selectslot. If already selected same slot AND signed pending+0x16>0, suppress duplicate queueing. Else enqueue dedicated control operation (if queue not full), set pending+0x16=0x4005.
Scenecontrol.no_match: CurrentID can change and ACK currentID even with no match/no queued control. Not a generic boolean success.
Scenecontrol.frame: Dedicated5x250 control queue: AA AA FF FF, byte8=3,9=6,10=inputlow8,11=4,12=0x34; helper0x80678ce sets byte13=2 and14=inputlow8; enqueue helper0x80678aa uses byte13=3. Ring-full helpers drop, callers can still set pending timers. No physical delivery claim.
